newsitem.title: POLAND: BP to build 100 petrol stations in Poland.
newsitem.headline: BP to build 100 petrol stations in Poland.

text.p: British Petroleum plans to increase the number of its petrol stations in Poland from the current 15 to 100 over the next four years, the spokeswoman of the firm's Polish unit said on Tuesday.
"According to our strategic goals some 100 filling stations will be built. We envisage opening about 20 stations annually," the spokeswoman, Dorota Adamska, told Reuters.
British Petroleum should have 35 Polish stations by the end of the year, she added. Each station would cost between $1.5 million and $2.0 million without costs of buying land.
Poland had 5,234 petrol stations in January this year, of which 26 percent belonged to the state-owned network CPN SA.
